command_timestamp_intervals.note: Publish/update intervals are measured directly from rosbag timestamps; no command period is hard-coded into the SG front end.

inferred_external_wrench.definition: piecewise-linear body wrench optimized so the fixed-parameter forward pose matches the geometric Savitzky-Golay pose estimate
inferred_external_wrench.initialization: required body wrench minus modeled body wrench
inferred_external_wrench.rollout_interpolation: continuous piecewise-linear interpolation between wrench knots

raw_inverse_dynamics_residual_wrench_sta.definition: required_body_wrench - modeled_body_wrench at raw centered SG evaluation times

savgol.parameter_loss_evaluation_times: all raw pose timestamps with a complete centered W-second window, intersected with actuator/dynamics support
savgol.rotation: degree-5 geometric Savitzky-Golay local polynomial on SO(3) (Jongeneel-Saccon IROS 2022)
savgol.translation: degree-5 local least-squares polynomial in R^3
savgol.translation_covariance: local ordinary-least-squares covariance estimated from position fit residuals when residual degrees of freedom are positive
savgol.window_definition: physical time width; all raw mocap pose samples inside each local window are used

method.description: raw-pose degree-5 local-polynomial gradient matching with geometric Savitzky-Golay filtering on SO(3), shared physical parameters, and command lag
method.name: deterministic_savgol_dynamics
method.parameter_data_objective: weighted empirical uncentered second moment of reference-scaled residual body wrench; no residual mean subtraction
method.pose_role: raw mocap pose supplies local degree-5 R3/SO3 polynomial fits

invalid_trial_evaluations.policy: invalid floating-point trial points are assigned a large fixed residual so the trust-region trial is rejected; the scientific parameter chart itself remains unbounded

selection.parameter_data_objective: 0.5 * weighted sample sum of squared reference-scaled residual body wrench

optimizer_tolerances.note: ftol and xtol are disabled by default in the SG estimator; gtol or max_nfev terminates the solve unless explicitly overridden
